learning_outcomes.text: Students gain an understanding of concepts and theories of Inner Development Goals to promote personal growth and development. In contrast to the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), which aim at global challenges, the IDGs focus on personal goals and the individual development process. These goals can be in various areas of life, such as personal development, professional growth, interpersonal relationships, or health and well-being. They learn basic principles of effective communication and teamwork, as well as techniques for time management and goal setting.

Students deepen their knowledge in specific areas such as leadership competence, conflict resolution, and decision-making. They intensely engage with advanced techniques and approaches for personal and professional development.

This field emphasizes understanding and critical reflection of the learned concepts. Students should be able to analyze theoretical approaches to self-development and interpersonal relationships and evaluate their relevance for their personal and professional lives.

Students apply the learned skills in practical exercises and transfer their knowledge to real-world scenarios. They practice how to effectively manage stress, resolve conflicts, and communicate and cooperate in team settings.

Within this competence field, students develop the ability to creatively adapt and further develop personal development techniques. They are encouraged to develop innovative approaches to managing challenges in personal and professional environments.

Students improve their communication skills and learn to interact effectively and empathetically in various social and professional contexts. They train how to work in teams and how to take on leadership and moderation tasks in groups.

In this field, students reflect on the ethical and social aspects of their personal and professional decisions. They develop an awareness of the responsibility that comes with applying self-management techniques and leadership skills, and critically consider their role in society and the professional environment.

syllabus_topics: Communication skills, leadership, and team management
Time and stress management, resilience, and adaptability
Critical thinking and creative problem solving
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance is a learning journal, which is prepared throughout the semester. The scope of the learning journal is 15 pages.
